_meta.title: Batch 3 — First Functional Domains (functional summaries only + AI pack unit)
_meta.version: V3 final (supersedes upload_ready/batch_3_functional_summary_selection.md: adds web_studio, base_automation and the AI pack unit — ladder rungs 3–4 and AI credibility)
_meta.goal: Teach Solaria the first important functional domains — narrative layer only; NO evidence files (models/views/security/workflow) in this batch.
_meta.prerequisite: Batch 2 uploaded AND its acceptance gate passed (>=8/10, no critical fail). AI items (order 17–18) additionally require the AI risk/legal review checkbox from HUMAN_GO_NO_GO_CHECKLIST.md.
_meta.gate_after_upload: acceptance_tests_AFTER_BATCH_3.md (>=10/12) AND red_team_tests.md (zero critical failures). Then STOP uploading (see future_upload_roadmap.md).

files.why_upload: Ladder rung 4 — corrects the 'automation needs Enterprise' misconception with evidence.
files.paste_ready_description: Primary business reference for the Odoo 19.0 base_automation module (Community): trigger→condition→action rules on any model, time-based cron, action vocabulary. Use for automation questions on any edition. Do not use for hard-blocking validations or workflow-engine emulation — native features first.

files.pass_criteria: No — base_automation is Community; Studio adds shape, rules add behaviour; AI steps = Enterprise.

files.why_upload: AI unit part 1: what the native AI layer actually does (verified), with gates. Requires AI risk/legal review checkbox.
